evidence.en:
I - I am reporting to you for the appropriate purposes that the aircraft BT: KPB, informally with rich details, the appearance of an OVNI in the positions Paracatu and Cristalina. The object observed by the aircraft was detected by the Gama radar, and after the controller initialized the runway, a significant variation in speed was observed. The movements reported by PT KPB coincided with the radar detections.

J - Furthermore, I clarify that the event occurred between 0040/0055Z on August 23, 1

Um piloto comercial relatou ter visto um objeto em forma de disco voador a uma altitude de 3.000 metros, movendo-se a uma velocidade de 240 km/h, em 15 de junho de 1951, sobre o estado de São Paulo, Brasil. O objeto era de cor prateada e tinha um brilho intenso. O piloto descreveu-o como um "disco voador" e estimou que ele tinha um diâmetro de 15 a 20 metros. O objeto se movia em um ângulo de 45 graus em relação ao solo e, em seguida, desapareceu repentinamente. O piloto não conseguiu identifica

I - In response to the provisions of MEMO n9 004/D0-41/78, I am reporting the following incident observed on 08 SET, during the 1400/2200 hours shift. "At approximately 2330Z, the aircraft PT-JKQ, operating the route SBBH/SBCT at FL390, reported seeing a large D0-41/78."
I - In accordance with the order of the Honorable Director of DEPV, I am sending to you copies of the reports on the events that occurred at DPV/DT 61 - Gama Site - on the night of June 20, 1978.

While on duty on August 22, 1978, Fondil was contacted by the Commander of the QD-460 regarding traffic at a specific position, corresponding to 09:00 hours on the clock.

Upon our denial, he reported traffic at the mentioned location; when inquired about the existence of such traffic, he confirmed it and later informed that it had disappeared. This occurred 65 nautical miles outside of Brasilia.
